path_step: System unavailability during deletion of an existing session.
test_scenario: Test the system's behavior when the session management service or database is unavailable during a session deletion attempt for FR-011.
test_case_title: Verify System Behavior on Service Unavailability during Session Deletion (FR-011)
pre_condition: Teacher is logged in, on the 'Sessions' tab of a course with at least one existing session. The session management service/database is simulated to be unavailable.
expected_result: System logs a critical error. A generic error message "Session management service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." is displayed. The session is not deleted.
post_condition: The session management service/database remains unavailable (for testing purposes), critical error logged, session list unchanged.

test_steps.step: Select a course to view its details.
Click the 'Delete' button next to an existing session.
Verify that a critical error is logged by the system.
Verify that a generic error message "Session management service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." is displayed to the user.
Verify that the session is still present in the list and has not been deleted.

uncovered_conditions: E1: System Unavailable for session management
